name: transformer-block-gemma4-12b
note: Full decoder block (Gemma 4 12B IT dense multimodal, text side): hidden 3072, 12 query heads, 4 KV heads shared (attention_k_eq_v true, so K and V share one projection), head_dim 256, GeGLU MLP intermediate 12288. Fused QKV = 12*256 (Q) + 4*256 (shared K/V) = 3072 + 1024 = 4096. o_proj: 12*256 -> 3072. GeGLU: single fused up projection to 2*12288 = 24576, act, then down 12288 -> 3072. use_qk_norm produces two extra RMSNorms on q/k which the linear-chain format folds into the pre-QKV norm.
